scenarios.generation: Set the GW covariance contribution identically to zero; never use a finite log amplitude as a substitute for zero.
scenarios.inference: Fit the declared signal-plus-noise model with its original finite log prior; this is an out-of-prior negative diagnostic, not SBC or a null-model Bayes factor.

coverage_reporting: Counts and pointwise 95 percent Clopper-Pearson intervals; no demand of universal nominal frequentist coverage for fixed-truth Bayesian intervals.

precision.interpretation: 32 repetitions are a coarse stress diagnostic. The N=500 precision statement belongs only to the separate prior-predictive campaign.

structural_exceptions: At u=0, [0,U90] has structural 100 percent coverage and F_u(0)=0; a constant support-boundary indicator is exact, not an unresolved sampled tail.
When GW amplitude is zero, mass and GW slope have no generating truth and receive no PIT, recovery bias or coverage score.
Other unresolved constant indicators remain failures under the applicable numerical protocol.
completion: Keep every realization, report numerical failures, and do not execute until the chosen ORF and posterior production pipeline have passed their separate validation.
